text:
Maya: Quick help pls — GreenArc renewal hit a procurement snag. They want to pay via PO instead of CC and insist on a vendor code + customer-managed KMS note in the SOW. Need to lock pricing/term before legal signs off.
Jordan: Got it. This is the 12mo renewal with the 20% concession we quoted, right?
Maya: Yup — 12mo, seats 75 -> 95. Pricing on the quote still applies. They asked explicitly for a PO flow and KMS requirement which is new.
Sam (Billing): We can accept PO. Vendor code to map is VA-GREEN-001. Need confirmed billing entity (Redwood Inc vs Redwood Inference) and the PO number to attach. Net30 default unless they ask otherwise.
Priya (Legal): I can take the SOW/addendum review. If they require customer-managed KMS/HSM we'll need an Appendix for key custody + DPA tweak. Any data residency constraints from the customer?
Devon (SE): GreenArc is currently on Dedicated. If they move to Private for KMS it's a deployment change — SEs need ~5 business days for onboarding and key exchange. If they want to keep Hosted, we can offer managed KMS with additional attestation.
Maya: Customer prefers Private for compliance. Can we offer customer-managed KMS with an HSM integration? @Priya can you draft the addendum that specifies key custody and rotation responsibilities?
Priya (Legal): On it. ETA EOD today for a first pass. One quick Q: who is the signing authority? We need the official signatory name & role for the e-sign package.
Jordan: Signatory is CFO Elena Park. She can sign but wants DocSend + internal PO number before legal routing.
Maya: Uploading SOW+quote to DocSend now: https://docsend.com/d/example — will update when PO# confirmed. @Sam please map the vendor code when you get the PO#.
Sam (Billing): Will do. Please provide PO# format — I'll map VA-GREEN-001 to Redwood Inc and attach PO# GA-2026-458. Flagging accounting to expect Net30.
Maya: Perfect — once Priya posts the addendum I'll send the e-sign request to Elena. Thanks all :thumbsup:
procurement-bot: Reminder: e-sign template 'Standard SOW v3' triggers KYC check if PO > $100k.
Maya: Noted. GreenArc PO is under threshold. Closing loop and will update thread when signed.
